scope: Sanitized diagnosis of the preserved Candidate 10 failure; no live operation

rejection.originalError: Audition trim rejected nonfinite or over-ceiling block; no clipping or automatic gain reduction
rejection.classificationBasis: The sealed renderer accumulates raw peak before Float32 output. Nonfinite raw output would poison that cumulative peak; the retained finite maximum exceeds the unchanged guard threshold and the accepted-block maximum. The final processed 512-frame block was not published. Finite startup multipliers and +12 dB cannot produce a nonfinite value from this bounded input.
rejection.remainingUncertainty: Exact offending sample, channel and unsampled path/pose state were not retained. Close-range point-source gain reproduces the same finite guard failure, but is not a reconstruction of every historical control.

chronology.receiptScope: SoundMap server receipt times of producer-stop and audio-discontinuity events, not exact guard execution-to-device timing

hostPrimary.message: InvalidOperationException: Producer starvation: stopped to prevent renderer/device clock drift; no automatic resume

chronology.attribution: Renderer guard rejection precedes PCM exhaustion; terminal starvation and underflow follow. The independently earlier processing miss is not relabelled as that terminal cause.

historicalTiming.sampledObservationCaveat: SoundMap deliberately samples about 16 Hz; these gaps include skipped genuine observations and are not the complete RPH getter cadence.
historicalTiming.publicationClockCaveat: Retained playout-bracket observation to solver publication, including configured 100 ms playout and observation bracketing. Do not add that 100 ms twice. Same-host UTC/QPC anchor conversion has millisecond wall-clock/anchor uncertainty and is not speaker time.
historicalTiming.nodeQueueCaveat: Historical geometry snapshot bypassed its Node queue aggregate; zero is unavailable evidence, not proof of zero queue latency.
historicalTiming.ringOccupancyCaveat: Historical queue occupancy was not retained. The 42.67 ms credit window is capacity/lead, not a constant delay measurement.

camera.assessment: Original timestamps, complete rejected block poses and per-observation generation transitions were not retained; no weakening of identity, freshness or 100 m/s discontinuity guards is justified.

gaps.explanation: Captured prefix is retained; failed host does not establish a complete listening session
